title: unified-rollouts: canary + shadow autorollback enhancements and observability
author: Ethan Brooks
commits: feat(rollouts): add weighted-canary controller hooks and policy evaluator
perf(routing): batch shadow proxy requests and reduce tail latency
fix(autorollback): quarantine metric quorum handling for transient spikes
test(e2e): add staged-shadow and canary autorollback integration tests
docs: rollout config examples and migration notes
description:
Motivation: production rollouts are increasingly using combined canary + shadow approaches. We observed two classes of failures during the last Dedicated release: (1) transient metric spikes causing unnecessary rollbacks, and (2) lack of visibility into shadow-only regressions. This PR improves autorollback stability and observability for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) without changing default behavior.

Summary of changes: 1) introduce a quorum-based quarantine stage so a single transient metric spike does not immediately trigger rollback; the controller now requires quorum across independent probes before escalating. 2) add weighted canary hooks to allow fractional traffic increases with explicit safety guards and staged time windows. 3) batch shadow proxy requests and add sampling to reduce cost and tail latency for high-throughput customers. 4) instrument new rollout metrics (rollout.stage, rollback.reason, shadow.regression_rate, quarantine.count) and add tracing hooks for correlated request ids. 5) add e2e tests covering staged-shadow probing and a small harness for simulating metric quorums.

Migration notes: existing rollout specs are backwards compatible. New fields are optional: "quorum": {"metric": ..., "threshold": ..., "window_secs": ...} and "weighted_canary": {"steps": [...]} — see docs.

Testing & validation: added unit tests for the quorum evaluator (coverage + edge cases), integration tests for the canary weight controller, and two new e2e scenarios that run against the perf-canary infra. CI passed locally and in CI after re-running a flaky integration test.

Rollout plan: feature flagged behind rollout.v2 gate. We will enable gated rollout for internal staging for 48h, promote to canary customers for 72h, then opt-in for broader release. Monitoring dashboards and alerts created in observability-pack; runbook updated.

Related: ENG-4123 (autorollback stability), ENG-4190 (shadow observability).
review_comments: Arielle Chen (review): Can we reduce the default quorum size for small customers? Suggest making quorum config optional with a reasonable default.
Ethan Brooks (author): Agree - added default quorum behavior in quarantine.go and documented in rollouts.md. Defaults target 3 independent probes or 5s window (configurable).
Diego Martez (review): Observability looks good; please add rollout.stage to the per-route dashboard and ensure tag cardinality is limited.
Ethan Brooks (author): Added rollout.stage metric and sanitized tag set to include only environment + rollout_id. Updated dashboards in observability-pack.
Sabrina Liu (review): Integration test flaked on first run (timeout). Can you add retry and increase timeouts for staging infra?
Ethan Brooks (author): Increased e2e timeouts and added a targeted retry for the flaky probe. Reran CI - green.
Arielle Chen: Approve after addressing comments.
release_notes: Improved autorollback stability via quorum-based quarantine; added weighted canary hooks, shadow batching to reduce tail latency, and rollout observability metrics. Backwards compatible.
